name: Storm Lantern
body:
Storm Lantern

School abjuration [air]; Level bard 0, druid 0, hunter 0, investigator 1, occultist 0, ranger 1, witch 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a glass bead)

EFFECT

Range touch
Area 1-foot radius
Target light source or flammable item touched
Duration 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw none (harmless, object); Spell Resistance no (harmless, object)

DESCRIPTION

A tiny sphere of still air forms at your touch, allowing you to kindle light and fire in all but the fiercest storms. The target counts as a protected light source when determining how it’s affected by weather and wind effects, including your attempts to light it.
